description: This file defines the ResourceLoader class, which models the <resource-loader> XML element in an OFBiz service configuration. It parses attributes such as name, class, prefix, and prepend-env from the provided XML element.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing a resource-loader element in service configuration XML, with fields for class name, name, prefix, and prepend environment variable.

methods.name: ResourceLoader(Element resourceLoaderElement)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ResourceLoader object by extracting and validating attributes from the provided XML element.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the resource loader.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix attribute for the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrependEnv
methods.description: Returns the prepend environment variable attribute.
